title: Law to create an office helping 9/11 responders and survivors
summary: This bill would create an Office of Assistance for 9/11 First Responders and Survivors within the Department of Social Services to connect people with benefits, housing, and healthcare services and provide case management. The office would issue a bill of rights for first responders and survivors and publish an annual report on its services starting one year after the law takes effect. It would also give individuals a receipt describing their request and next steps within 15 days.
